_note: VALIDATION-ONLY. These module definitions validate a SKU and seed its qa_checklist (buildPromptForSku in src/lib/bestBottlesPromptCompiler.ts). The prompt text they would assemble is DISCARDED and NOT shipped: the prompt that actually reaches the image model is the vendored canon (src/config/bestBottlesCatalogCanon.ts) + the per-family framing profile (src/config/bestBottlesFamilyProfiles.ts), assembled by buildFinalPrompt() in src/lib/bestBottlesPromptPreflight.ts. Do not treat this file as the source of the catalog image prompt.

prompt_lines: Preserve the roll-on bottle as a compact cylindrical fragrance package with exact roller plug geometry and cap state.
If the over-cap is detached in the reference, keep exactly one upright over-cap on the shared baseline.
Preserve the Cylinder bottle's exact tube geometry, circular base, vertical sidewalls, shoulder and neck proportions, and SKU-specific applicator identity.
Keep sibling Cylinder SKUs aligned on one consistent family baseline and centerline.
Preserve the Boston Round shoulder curve, cylindrical body, neck finish, and exact closure/applicator relationship.
Do not sharpen the shoulders or turn the bottle into a Cylinder family shape.
Preserve the Circle bottle's flattened round body, broad circular shoulders, short neck finish, and exact closure/applicator relationship.
Do not turn the Circle family silhouette into a tall Cylinder or Boston Round profile.
Preserve flat front and side panels, rectangular footprint, panel proportions, and exact corner radius.
Keep vertical edges crisp without adding fake bevels or faceted geometry.
Preserve the Empire bottle's decorative silhouette, shoulder geometry, base footprint, and neck proportions.
Improve lighting and material separation without simplifying the ornamental outline.
Preserve classic spray pump geometry, actuator/nozzle, collar stack, and cap state exactly from the reference.
The sprayer must remain seated on the bottle centerline.
Preserve the fine mist sprayer actuator, nozzle face, collar, cap state, trim finish, and any visible dip tube.
Pale or clear cap surfaces must stay readable against the Bone background.
Preserve the refillable atomizer as an opaque colored/anodized metal shell with exact sleeve proportions and sprayer/cap transitions.
Do not render glass wall thickness, refraction, liquid, or an internal dip tube through the metal shell.
Preserve the dropper assembly, collar, rubber bulb, pipette geometry if visible, and exact body proportions.
Do not add spray actuators, hoses, tassels, or extra caps.
Preserve the vial's small scale, narrow cylindrical proportions, neck finish, and closure identity.
Keep glass or plastic wall thickness appropriate to the SKU material.
Preserve the reducer insert and drop-control opening as the product identity.
Do not replace the reducer with a dropper, sprayer, or roller assembly.
Preserve the splash bottle neck/closure state exactly and do not add a pump, sprayer, roller, or dropper.
Keep the neck thread and bottle mouth readable.
Preserve the vintage bulb sprayer assembly, hose path, collar, tassel if present, and all textile color relationships.
Keep bulb, hose, and tassel fully visible inside the safe zone.
Preserve decorative contours, facets, embossing, and exact closure relationship.
Enhance edge definition without redesigning the ornamental form.
Preserve the apothecary silhouette, shoulder curve, neck finish, closure state, and material identity.
Do not add labels, text, or pharmaceutical markings.
Preserve lotion pump head geometry, stem, collar, and exact pump orientation.
Keep pump parts crisp and readable, including pale plastic edges.
Preserve opaque aluminum material, satin/brushed grain direction, body shape, and closure relationship.
Do not use transparent glass, liquid, caustics, or refraction language for the body.
Preserve the cream jar's low wide stance, lid diameter, lid height, and body wall geometry.
Use the low-wide frame class; do not stretch it into a tall bottle.
Preserve bag silhouette, fabric texture, seams, drawstring details, and folded volume.
Do not make fabric glossy, glassy, metallic, or plastic.
Preserve box panel proportions, folding carton edges, flap lines, and exact front-face geometry.
Do not add branding, labels, text, windows, or decorative graphics unless present in the reference.
Preserve every accessory component, material, orientation, count, and relative scale exactly.
Use grouped accessory framing only when multiple components belong to the SKU.
